review:
A space-themed cluster game with Jolt Frames that work a lot like Sun Princess's Sun Rays: a frame lands on a symbol at the start of a spin, then spreads in straight lines once wins are paid, turning everything it touches into that symbol.

The twist is the Chain Reaction – if a spread crosses a symbol of the same type, a new frame pops up there and spreads again, which in theory can fill the board. The Lift Off Luck bonus improves the frame odds. 10,000x max.
